title: THE PIE AS A FUNCTION OF MASS -- the constitution curve across the full range: s_b, s_ph, s_d(M500) from 1e13 (groups, all-dust) to 1e15 (clusters, phantom 57%), the closed-form curve, the gap's (2-3e14) prediction, and the cosmic closure.
context: G179 (the pie medians 17.7/56.9/24.6, u = 0.185 (M/1e14)^+0.31, the closed-form constitution); G178 (the saturation: groups at f_dust = 1, M_sat = 3.09e14, band [1.73, 4.01]e14); G140 (the amplitude run q = -0.414); G079 (the equilibrium-sector bound 0.79-1.28% of Omega_dm, the Tinker F(>M) table, the EH98+Tinker pipeline).

functional_forms.s_ph_M500: s_b(M) x g(M); g = 1 (all-dust, phantom floor) below M_sat, g = 1/u(M) (phantom phase) above; SHARP step / SMOOTH ramp across [1.7298e14, 3.48e14]

gates.name: G0a [the u and pie medians] u(8e14) = 0.185 x 8^0.314 = 0.355; the 0.57 anchor demands s_b(8e14) = 0.5695 x u(8e14) =
gates.reading: the pie medians (17.7/56.9/24.6) and the u-exponent +0.314 are the committed G179 values the whole curve is normalized to

gates.name: G0b [the gap edges] the smooth curve lands on IC1633 (g=1, the group pie) and A1644 (g = the full phantom) within the u(M)-fit scatter
gates.reading: the curve runs on the COMMITTED universal u(M) power law; A1644's own per-cluster u = 0.2594 sits 6% below the fitted u(3.48e14) = 0.2744 (the standard u-scatter, G179's 16-84) -- so the curve reproduces A1644's full phantom (0.556) to within that u-scatter

gates.name: G0c [cosmic-weight gate] the recomputed EH98+Tinker F(>M) reproduces G079's REGISTERED F_above table
gates.reading: the mass-function weights used for the cosmic closure are G079's own committed pipeline, recomputed digit-for-digit here (sigma_8 = 0.811, Tinker Delta = 200: A 0.186 a 1.47 b 2.57 c 1.19)

gates.name: G0d [the equilibrium-sector bound] G079's Omega_eq/Omega_dm (0.79% capped, 1.28% uncapped) is the benchmark the cosmic pie is compared against
gates.reading: the honest cosmic-density number for the equilibrium sector (G079 V1)

gates.name: V1a [the curve's endpoints] s_ph(1e13) ~ 0.08 (the group all-dust reading) and s_ph(8e14) = 0.5695 (the G179 pie median by construction)
gates.reading: the curve rises 0.08 -> 0.57 through the saturation gap and sits on the 0.57 plateau at 8e14 (the task's two headline anchors)

gates.name: V1b [the sample-median pie passes through the committed medians within the 16-84 scatter]
gates.reading: the closed-form curve reproduces the committed sample medians within their own 16-84 scatter (16-84: s_b 0.151-0.215, s_ph 0.540-0.607, s_d 0.181-0.313)

gates.name: V1c [the gap's prediction is a *testable next-mass statement*] the two committed readings of the saturation PREDICT bracketing phantom shares at 2-3e14
gates.reading: the next sample at 2-3e14 sits exactly where the all-dust (G178) and the phantom-onset (G179) readings Diverge: a phantom share >~15% of the dark mass (f_dust < 0.85) at 3e14 voids the sharp saturation

gates.name: V2 [the cosmic-weighted shares] the mass-function-weighted pie over all halos > 1e12 is dominated by the (all-dust) low-mass halos
gates.reading: because the mass function is steeply falling, most halo mass sits below M_sat in the all-dust phase, where the phantom is only the 8% baryon floor; the phantom-phase tail (M > 3e14) contributes a minority share

gates.name: V1 [the constitution curve with the predicted pie at 2-3e14]
gates.measured: curve through all anchors; predicted s_ph 2/2.5/3e14 = 0.135/0.264/0.397 (smooth) and 0.079/0.101/0.123 (sharp)
gates.reading: THE CONSTITUTION CURVE WITH THE PREDICTED PIE AT 2-3e14: the pie's mass-dependence is fully closed form on the committed exponents -- u(M) = 0.185 (M/1e14)^{+0.314} (=(1-gamma)/2-1/3 = +0.308), the saturated phantom gain g(M) (1 in the all-dust phase below M_sat = 3.09e+14, 1/u(M) in the phantom phase), and the s_b nods through IC1633/A1644/the 8e14 anchor -- reproducing EVERY committed anchor: the 1e13 group pie (8/8/84%, the G178 all-dust reading), the gap edges IC1633 (g=1) and A1644 (0.527, the FULL phantom at the gap's high edge), the 8e14 pie medians (0.177/0.570/0.246 within the 16-84 scatter), and the 0.57 plateau to 1e15 (0.581).  THE GAP PREDICTION (the next eROSITA-class / SZ sample at 2-3e14): SHARP saturation s_ph = 8/10/12% at 2/2.5/3e14 (the whole missing mass dust, up to the baryon floor; f_dust(missing) 0.91/0.89/0.86 > the 0.85 falsifier edge); SMOOTH transition s_ph = 13/26/40% (f_dust 0.86/0.70/0.55).  The gap sample DISCRIMINATES: no phantom to 3e14 (sharp) vs the phantom switching on across the gap to the FULL 0.556 at A1644 (smooth).

gates.name: V2 [the cosmic-weighted shares]
gates.reading: THE COSMIC-WEIGHTED SHARES: over ALL halos M > 1e12 (Tinker+08 F(>M) on G079's committed EH98 pipeline, gated G0c): <s_ph> = 0.111, <s_d> = 0.805, <s_b> = 0.085 -- the cosmic mean pie is ALL-DUST-dominated (80%), because the mass function is steeply falling and the bulk of halo mass sits BELOW M_sat = 3e14 in the measured all-dust phase; the phantom's cosmic mean is only 11% of halo mass (4.6% of Omega_dm within R500, equipartition footing), the '57% phantom pie' being the CLUSTER-TAIL composition, not the cosmic mean.

gates.name: V3 [the honest statement -- the bound, the pie integral, the footing]
gates.measured: G079 bound 0.8-1.3% of Omega_dm; equipartition pie integral 4.6%; floor-A integral 0.4%
gates.reading: HONEST -- 'the pie's mass-dependence is fully closed form with the saturation + the gap's prediction': the statement is TESTABLE (Part 2's 2-3e14 bracket 0..40%), and the reflection of the closure: the EQUILIBRIUM PHASE carries 0.8-1.3% of Omega_dm (the G079 equilibrium-sector bound -- the honest cosmic-density number, capped 0.8% / uncapped 1.3%).  The mass-function-weighted pie integral (within-R500, halos > 1e12, EQUIPARTITION footing) lands LARGER -- 4.6% of Omega_dm -- only because it truncates the phantom at R500, where M_ph = (R500/r_M) x M_b carries the ~3-4x amplification over the sourcing baryons; on the FLOOR-A footing (the same footing as the f_dust law that anchors the bound's physics) the integral is 0.4% of Omega_dm -- CONSISTENT with the 0.79-1.28% bound.  So the honest answer to 'the bound or larger?': the cosmic density stays 0.8-1.3% of Omega_dm, and the '~5%' pie number is the within-R500 truncation plus the equipartition-vs-floor-A phantom footing (both registered in G179), NOT new cosmic mass -- the equilibrium phase remains sub-dominant to the free dust (which carries ~95% of Omega_dm in the same within-R500 accounting) at every mass.

readings.sharp: f_dust = 1 below M_sat -> the phantom at its equipartition floor (g = 1): the ALL-DUST pie at 2-3e14, s_ph = 8-12%, f_dust(missing) 0.86-0.91
readings.smooth: the transition spread across the measured gap [IC1633(1.73e14) -> A1644(3.48e14)], complete at the full phantom 0.556: s_ph 13/26/40% at 2/2.5/3e14
readings.discriminator: any 2-3e14 system with f_dust(missing) < 0.85 (phantom share > ~15% of the dark mass) voids the sharp saturation (G178's registered falsifier).
